product.name: Devyce Essentials
product.description: A VoIP communication platform designed for small teams to manage calls, messaging, and CRM integration with basic analytics and multi-number management.

product.name: Devyce Enhance
product.description: A VoIP platform for larger teams featuring AI call summaries, live call monitoring, API access, and dedicated support for improved communication management.

product.name: Devyce Enterprise
product.description: A scalable VoIP communication solution for large organizations with advanced analytics, custom integrations, priority support, and centralized billing.

product.name: Recruiters Plan
product.description: A VoIP communication service tailored for recruitment professionals, featuring AI-driven call summaries, CRM integration, and workflow automation.
